original_record.organizer: T.C. Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı (Ministry of National Education), in protocol with the Grand National Assembly of Türkiye (TBMM)
original_record.host_institution: Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi (TBMM) hosts the national-level convening
original_record.eligibility_verbatim: Official MEB directive 'Demokrasi Eğitimi ve Okul Meclisleri Yönergesi' applies to 'her derece ve türdeki İlköğretim ve Ortaöğretim kurumlarında' (all elementary and secondary/high-school institutions, public and private). Each school elects an Okul Öğrenci Meclisi (School Student Council) by secret, free, equal, single-tier, general vote ('gizli, serbest, eşit, tek dereceli ve genel oy'); school council presidents form the İl Öğrenci Meclisi (Provincial Student Council); provincial presidents form the Türkiye Öğrenci Meclisi, which convenes in the TBMM General Assembly hall during National Sovereignty Week. Candidates must not have been sanctioned by the school Honor/Discipline Board.
original_record.eligible_grades: İlköğretim ve Ortaöğretim — all secondary grades, including lise (high school), are covered
original_record.turkey_access_reasoning: This is a Türkiye-only civics program for students enrolled at any Turkish public or private school; every student council candidacy starts with a school-level election open to that school's own students.
original_record.international_access_notes: Not applicable — Türkiye's own national program, not open to students outside the Turkish school system.
original_record.team_or_national_delegation_required: No team application; individual candidacy at school level, then indirect (delegate) election upward to province and national levels.
original_record.current_cycle_label: Annual — school council elections held each October; Türkiye Öğrenci Meclisi convenes annually during National Sovereignty Week (per protocol between TBMM and MEB)
